descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S10 Nursing Home: an open task 4 days and 3 visits old, last processed 2 days ago, is still open at today's visit, on the chart and on Task Export

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Nursing Home open tasks persist across visits (UAT 3.6: open tasks persist until changed) (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.6; TFA-92585 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given A resident seeded with three earlier visits (server-today − 4 d, − 3 d, − 2 d), chart last processed server now − 2 d, and an open task created at the first of them (server now − 4 d); on Today's Visits

When Open Task Export; open the resident, type a pre-round text and tap Save Note (today's visit starts); open Post-Round; open Task Export again

Then The task is open under the resident on Task Export before and after today's visit starts, and on the chart's Post-Round tab

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U6 / 3.6 Nursing Home 'open tasks persist until changed'. The task is older than 36 h, the chart was last processed more than 36 h ago and the task predates the 'last two visits' window, so a Hospital-style 36 h open-task clear or a visit-window clear leaking into Nursing Home would remove it (with a 1-day-old seed it would not). …

Where it ran: dev; test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) (TIME (back-dated seed: three earlier visits, notesProcessedAt -2 d, task created -4 d)); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
